focus: The Media Editor plugin as a packaging precedent
noveltyJustification: All six findings are new plugin-build evidence; the plugin was only knew by name before this iteration.
ruledOut: Hand-maintaining the copy in the plugin directory
Copying the no-MCP-server choice for a FigJam plugin

findings.label: Plugin identity is minimal: a five-field plugin.json plus a one-plugin local marketplace whose source is ./.
The plugin is a build output: npm run plugin unpacks server/, copies the skill into skills/sk-media-editor/ and writes bin/ shims, and all three directories are untracked.
The copied skill is a wholesale copy of ../../sk-media-editor/, the build replaces the whole skills folder each time, and the copy is never treated as a source.
The build enforces three refusals that solve duplicate drift: any copied file differing from its source, a server unpacking with links, and a plugin.json registering an MCP server.

The plugin registers no MCP server, an accepted cost: claude.ai and Cowork refuse a plugin with a bin folder, so it reaches Claude Code only and a claude.ai Project needs an MCP-based Desktop extension.
Runtime cost sits outside the plugin: Node 20.9.0 must already be on the session PATH, and one pinned ffmpeg build exists per platform.
